title: PBKDF2 completeness: SHA384/SHA512 tests + kcapi
description:
Fix two gaps in PBKDF2 support:

1. wolfssl already implements pbkdf2(sha384) and pbkdf2(sha512) via wc_PBKDF2(WC_SHA384/WC_SHA512) but there are no test vectors and no test_kdf.c test cases for them. Only pbkdf2(sha256) is tested.

2. kcapi_kdf.c has no PBKDF2 implementation despite DESIGN.md claiming kcapi=yes for all three pbkdf2 variants. The file header comment also lists pbkdf2 as a supported algorithm. This is an implementation gap.

What needs to be done:
1. Add PBKDF2-SHA384 and PBKDF2-SHA512 known-answer vectors to tests/vectors/ (from OpenSSL or pyca/cryptography)
2. Add pbkdf2(sha384) and pbkdf2(sha512) test cases to tests/userspace/test_kdf.c, including validation rejection tests (iterations < 1000, salt too short)
3. Implement kcapi PBKDF2 in kcapi_kdf.c using crypto_alloc_shash("hmac(sha384)") etc., manually iterating the PRF — same approach as the manual HKDF implementation
4. Update DESIGN.md algorithm coverage table to accurately reflect kcapi PBKDF2 status (or mark as — if kernel API research shows it is not feasible on all target kernels)
